item.createsprings.portative_steam_engin: A small Steam Engine capable of charging tools, lighting the way, and also warming and accelerating players
Allows for a Steam Dash when the pressure level is above 70, Also reduces the pressure
item.createsprings.punchcard.tooltip.sum: Can program some tools by executing simple instructions in cycle, can hold a small amount of commands
item.createsprings.punchcard.tooltip.beh: if punchcard is in a tool and it is waiting for activation, the next instruction will be executed instantly
item.createsprings.sus_package.tooltip.s: This package when dropped from a height or destroyed, releases a spring that bounces off blocks or entities
item.createsprings.hat.tooltip.summary: A hat. can be dyed or placed on the ground and also can store 1 stack of items, if engineer goggles are inside it will function as engineer goggles
item.createsprings.spring_base.tooltip.s: A Base for spring-powered tools, can hold up to 2 springs to transform it into a spring tool place a modifier inside
item.createsprings.spring_base.tooltip.c: When a spring is stacked on the tool
A spring-powered drill, Can hold up to 2 springs Mining speed depends on the tool's speed
R-click with a tripwire hook in the tool
Instantly releases the spring charge in the tool, converting it to extreme speed
item.createsprings.spring_saw.tooltip.su: A spring-powered saw, Can hold up to 2 springs Harvesting speed depends on the tool's speed
item.createsprings.spring_saw.tooltip.co: R-click with a tripwire hook in the tool
item.createsprings.spring_saw.tooltip.be: Instantly releases the spring charge in the tool, converting it to extreme speed
A spring-powered shovel, Can hold up to 2 springs Harvesting speed depends on the tool's speed
R-click with a tripwire hook in the tool
Instantly releases the spring charge in the tool, converting it to extreme speed
item.createsprings.spring_fan.tooltip.su: A portable spring-powered Fan, Can hold up to 2 springs, pushes entities to or from the player, direction changes when Shift is pressed, Works on elytra.
item.createsprings.spring_fan.tooltip.co: R-click with a tripwire hook in the tool
item.createsprings.spring_fan.tooltip.be: Instantly releases the spring charge in the tool, converting it to extreme speed
item.createsprings.spring_launcher.toolt: A powerful weapon that can fire springs or spring alloy blocks, scope can be added by placing a spyglass inside
R-click with springs in the launcher
releases a spring that bounces off blocks or entities
R-click with a spring and a spring alloy block in the launcher
fires a spring alloy block that explodes on landing
item.createsprings.explosion_chamber.too: A durable chamber for springs charging
R-click with a spring and fuel in the chamber
createsprings.pse.tooltip.5: increasing the speed of spring tools
createsprings.pse.tooltip.overdrive: when _overdrive_ is turned on _PSE_ will work with maximum speed in any mode, but _pressure_ in engine will constantley _rise_, When _pressure_ hits _100_ engine _explodes_
createsprings.pse.tooltip.overdrive2: you will be able to do _steam dash_ when pressure is more than 70 to lower pressure but it is a _temporary measure_
createsprings.pse.tooltip.water: when there is _no water_ in the engine, _PSE_ will try find _water bucket_ in the _inventory_ if it finds _water bucket_ inner tank will be _restored_ and water bucket _wouldn't be spent_
